CustomField.description: Convention: one year past this transaction's date. Blank means no time restriction. Interpretation is report-defined — no automatic release logic. On a payment against a commitment, defaults from the parent commitment but is independently writable — installments of a multi-year pledge may each carry their own release date. Populated automatically by FQSSeedGenerator on grant-multiyear and grant-custom installments. See .planning/fqs-designations-plan.md.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The date restricted funds from this payment become available for either general use or for their designated purpose.
